name: OK-02
label: Safe R

key_factors: Prediction markets price ~2% Democratic win chance
model.rationale: The R+28 district, an incumbent Republican, and a Democratic challenger with negligible fundraising make this a Safe R race; prediction markets agree at roughly a 2% Democratic chance.
model.watch: Nothing realistic here; only a major scandal or incumbent retirement would matter, and neither is indicated.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Oklahoma's 2nd District is one of the most Republican-leaning seats in the country, with a partisan lean of about R+28. Incumbent Josh Brecheen is running for re-election after winning the seat in 2022, and no serious outside spending or expert attention targets this race.

Democratic nominee Brandon Wade has raised only about $4,300 with under $100 on hand, giving him no resources to compete. Prediction markets give him roughly a 2% chance of winning. The forecast is a Safe R seat with an expected Republican margin in the low twenties.
